title: Artificial Intelligence in Manufacturing: Predictive Maintenance & Computer Vision
workplace_track: Emerging Tech: AI & Industrial Machine Learning
description: Specialized smart manufacturing English module analyzing machine learning anomaly detection, computer vision sorting, and edge IoT diagnostics.
learning_objectives: Master industrial AI lexicon (computer vision, anomaly detection, edge computing, acoustic sensors, neural networks)
Apply conditional logic and duration tenses to automated diagnostic alarms
Eliminate Czech interference errors when explaining predictive algorithms and sensor telemetry

questions.prompt: Before deploying the neural network onto the food packaging line, computer vision engineers _____ the camera exposure.

explanations.correct: Modal 'must' is directly followed by the bare infinitive 'calibrate' without 'to'.
explanations.wrong_A: 'must to' is ungrammatical; modals never take 'to'.
explanations.wrong_C: 'is must' is completely ungrammatical in English.

questions.cz_learning_point: Po způsobovém slovesu 'must' následuje vždy holý infinitiv bez 'to': 'must calibrate' (nikoli *must to calibrate*).
questions.workplace_track: Emerging Tech: AI & Industrial Machine Learning

questions.prompt: If the acoustic edge sensor _____ abnormal high-frequency bearing vibrations, the AI triggers an automated maintenance ticket.

explanations.correct: First conditional if-clause takes Present Simple ('detects') for automated operational rules.
explanations.wrong_A: Cannot use future modal 'will' inside an if-clause.
explanations.wrong_B: Cannot use 'would' in a real First Conditional.
explanations.wrong_D: Past tense 'detected' would conflict with present indicative 'triggers'.

questions.cz_learning_point: V podmínkových větách s 'if' se nesmí použít 'will' (*If the sensor will detect*). Použijte přítomný čas: 'If the sensor detects'.
questions.workplace_track: Emerging Tech: AI & Industrial Machine Learning

questions.prompt: The edge inference device streams raw thermal telemetry to the cloud gateway _____ the ammonia compressor is running at full capacity.

explanations.correct: 'While' is a conjunction followed by a full continuous clause ('the ammonia compressor is running').
explanations.wrong_B: 'During' is a preposition and must be followed by a noun phrase, not a finite clause.
explanations.wrong_D: 'Since' denotes elapsed time from a starting point or causation.

questions.cz_learning_point: Spojka 'while' se pojí s celou větou se slovesem (while the compressor is running), zatímco 'during' se pojí pouze s podstatným jménem.
questions.workplace_track: Emerging Tech: AI & Industrial Machine Learning

questions.prompt: Factory quality protocols require that machine learning defect models _____ every month against newly annotated edge data.

explanations.correct: Passive with modal 'should be retrained' correctly describes how models must be updated.
explanations.wrong_A: Active 'should retrain' implies models retrain themselves.
explanations.wrong_B: 'should to be' is ungrammatical; modal 'should' does not take 'to'.

questions.cz_learning_point: Trpný rod se způsobovým slovesem: 'should be retrained' (měly by být přetrénovány). Modely se nepřetrénovávají samy.
questions.workplace_track: Emerging Tech: AI & Industrial Machine Learning

questions.prompt: The data science team _____ vibration anomalies on ammonia screw compressor 2 for the past three weeks.

explanations.correct: Present Perfect Continuous ('has been monitoring') correctly expresses an ongoing action lasting from the past into the present ('for the past three weeks').
explanations.wrong_A: Present Simple expresses habitual routines, not ongoing duration.
explanations.wrong_B: Past Simple implies the monitoring has completely stopped.

questions.cz_learning_point: Předpřítomný průběhový čas (Present Perfect Continuous: 'has been monitoring') vyjadřuje děj, který začal v minulosti a stále trvá ('for the past three weeks').
questions.workplace_track: Emerging Tech: AI & Industrial Machine Learning

questions.prompt: Sensor readings are pre-processed on localized microcontrollers _____ cloud transmission bandwidth can be minimized.

explanations.correct: 'So that' is a conjunction of purpose followed by a subject and modal verb clause ('bandwidth can be minimized').
explanations.wrong_C: 'because of' is followed by a noun phrase, not a clause with a finite verb.

questions.cz_learning_point: Účelová spojka 'so that' = aby (následovaná celou větou se způsobovým slovesem: 'so that bandwidth can be minimized').
questions.workplace_track: Emerging Tech: AI & Industrial Machine Learning

questions.prompt: The high-speed optical sorter will automatically _____ any frozen carton with an illegible or smeared barcode.

explanations.correct: Phrasal verb 'weed out' (to eliminate or reject defective items) takes base form after future auxiliary 'will'.
explanations.wrong_A: 'weed out to' adds an unnecessary preposition.
explanations.wrong_C: Past form 'weeded out' is ungrammatical after auxiliary 'will'.

questions.cz_learning_point: Frázové sloveso 'weed out' (vyřadit / vyselektovat vadné kusy). Po pomocném slovesu 'will' následuje základní tvar: 'will weed out'.
questions.workplace_track: Emerging Tech: AI & Industrial Machine Learning

questions.prompt: The automated facility relies on smart piezoelectric sensors, _____ sampling frequency exceeds 20 kilohertz.

explanations.correct: Possessive relative pronoun 'whose' correctly links the antecedent 'sensors' with its attribute 'sampling frequency'.
explanations.wrong_C: 'that' cannot be used in non-defining relative clauses set off by commas.
explanations.wrong_D: 'what' cannot function as a relative pronoun with an explicit antecedent.

questions.cz_learning_point: Přivlastňovací vztažné zájmeno 'whose' (jejichž vzorkovací frekvence) se v technické angličtině běžně používá i pro neživé předměty a přístroje.
questions.workplace_track: Emerging Tech: AI & Industrial Machine Learning

questions.prompt: Given that the neural network's confidence score exceeds 99.8%, this thermal image anomaly _____ a failing rotor bearing.

explanations.correct: 'Must be' expresses strong logical deduction based on high mathematical confidence.
explanations.wrong_A: 'must to be' is ungrammatical; modals never take 'to'.
explanations.wrong_B: 'can to be' is ungrammatical in English.

questions.cz_learning_point: Logická dedukce (určitě to musí být porucha): 'must be a failing bearing'. Nikdy *must to be*.
questions.workplace_track: Emerging Tech: AI & Industrial Machine Learning

questions.prompt: The robotic packaging cell cannot resume autonomous operation _____ the computer vision safety zone is verified clear.

explanations.correct: 'Unless' expresses 'if not' or 'except when', stating the mandatory safety condition for restart.
explanations.wrong_A: 'if' produces an illogical contradiction (cannot run IF verified clear).
explanations.wrong_C: 'provided that' creates an illogical positive condition.
explanations.wrong_D: 'as long as' also creates an illogical condition.

questions.cz_learning_point: 'Unless' = pokud ne (if not). Po 'unless' už v anglické větě nenásleduje další zápor: 'unless the safety zone is verified clear'.
questions.workplace_track: Emerging Tech: AI & Industrial Machine Learning
